core: Regulation of insulin and glucagon secretion
qualifier: by GPCR ligands and cAMP-PKA signalling
name: GPCR and cAMP-PKA regulation of insulin and glucagon secretion
rationale: Members are islet hormone secretion controls via fatty acid, GLP-1, adrenergic and cholinergic receptors plus glucagon-PKA/PDE3B signalling, whereas confusables centre on insulin receptor action, glucose uptake and LXR-driven lipid metabolism.

name: Major spliceosome assembly and splice-site recognition
rationale: All members cover U2-type spliceosome assembly, splice-site recognition and catalytic activation, while confusables concern snRNA transcription, snRNP biogenesis and splicing regulation.

name: NK and cytotoxic T cell activation and immune tolerance
rationale: Members span NK and T cell cytotoxicity, NK receptor signatures, T cell activation and tolerance/anergy with dendritic cell regulation, whereas confusables focus on regulatory T cell differentiation and T cell suppression.

name: Direct removal of methyl and alkyl groups from DNA bases
rationale: Members are ALKBH2/3 and MGMT alkylation reversal and TET/TDG cytosine demethylation, which distinguishes them from confusables on base excision repair, cytidine deamination and redox metabolism.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell maintenance and restraint of lineage differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC proliferation, homeostasis and division and negatively regulate myeloid and B lineage differentiation, unlike confusables centred on RUNX1 programs, erythroid-megakaryocyte and granulocyte development.

qualifier: thymic and peripheral T cell expression signatures
name: T cell activation and differentiation expression signatures
rationale: Members are mostly T cell activation, signalling and thymocyte differentiation signatures with minor B/NK modules, distinguishing them from confusables dominated by B cell development and BCR signalling.

name: Atrial and AV node cardiomyocyte action potential
rationale: All three members concern membrane potential changes in atrial and AV node cells, whereas confusables cover ventricular, Purkinje and general cardiac action potential phases.

qualifier: presynaptic calcium-channel and glutamate receptor control
name: Presynaptic excitability control and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members combine neuronal excitability and presynaptic regulation (calcium channels, mGluR, active zone, GABA genes) with sensory and motor behaviours, while confusables add glycinergic transmission and broader behaviour and brain development.

name: NOD1/NOD2 sensing of bacterial peptidoglycan
rationale: Members describe NOD1/2 responses to peptidoglycan and muramyl dipeptide with K63 ubiquitination, distinguishing them from TLR-TAK1-NF-kB confusables and the IPAF inflammasome.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor-driven mast cell activation and degranulation
rationale: Members are FcERI signalling branches and mast cell activation, degranulation and type I hypersensitivity, unlike confusables centred on Th2 and eosinophil responses.

name: Fructose-2,6-bisphosphate regulation of glycolysis and lactate production
rationale: Members cover fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt and lactate fermentation, while confusables add hexokinase and fructose-1,6-bisphosphate steps or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programs.

name: PTK6 (BRK) tyrosine kinase signalling
rationale: Every member is a PTK6 activation, effector or downregulation event, whereas confusables are broad RTK, PI3K-AKT and RAS-MAPK signalling.

name: Th2 differentiation and type 2 cytokine response
rationale: Members cover Th2 differentiation, IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 production, IL-33 and IL-4/13 signalling and IgE switching, distinguishing them from eosinophil-focused and FcERI mast cell confusables.

qualifier: natural-product toxins and steroids, with sulfonation
name: Detoxification of natural-product xenobiotics and steroids
rationale: Members span metabolism of mycotoxins, flavones, polyketides and steroids with sulfonation and toxin catabolism, whereas confusables emphasise drug ADME, organic anion transport and CYP/FMO oxidation of aromatic amines and alcohols.

name: Arp2/3-mediated lamellipodium and ruffle protrusion
rationale: Members regulate Arp2/3 nucleation via WASP/WAVE and lamellipodium, ruffle, podosome and pseudopodium assembly, unlike confusables involving filament severing, capping, crosslinking and Rho GTPase cycles.

qualifier: zinc, manganese, cadmium uptake and iron export
name: Zinc, manganese and cadmium uptake and iron efflux defects
rationale: Members cover SLC39 zinc/manganese/cadmium import and ferroportin/ceruloplasmin iron export defects, distinguishing them from confusables on copper, metallothionein, heme and transferrin iron uptake.

name: Heparan sulfate degradation and Sanfilippo syndromes
rationale: Members are heparan sulfate catabolism and MPS IIIA-D defects (plus CS/DS degradation), whereas confusables hold the other MPS types and chondroitin/keratan sulfate degradation.

name: Fibroblast survival, migration and myofibroblast differentiation
rationale: Members regulate fibroblast apoptosis, migration and myofibroblast/cardiac fibroblast differentiation, while confusables add TGF-beta, ECM assembly and collagen regulation.

qualifier: sensing and classical non-homologous end joining
name: DNA double-strand break sensing and classical end joining
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, ATM recruitment, chromatin remodelling and classical NHEJ, distinguishing them from confusables with alternative NHEJ, BRCA1/2 defects and homologous recombination.

name: Sphingomyelin-derived ceramide signalling and IGF response
rationale: Members form two linked strands, sphingomyelin catabolism/TNFR1 ceramide production with hormone-mediated apoptosis and responses to IGF/peptide, unlike confusables on FOXO, bone or ceramide homeostasis.

name: Osteoblast proliferation, differentiation and bone mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation and bone mineralization, while confusables add Wnt, mesenchymal stem cell, trabecula and tendon development.

name: Amino acid and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: Members cover leucine/methionine and glucose starvation sensing, LKB1-AMPK and AKT-TSC control of mTORC1, unlike confusables on p53/glycolysis, FOXO or translation and methylation.

name: TCA cycle and lipoyl and iron-sulfur cofactor assembly
rationale: Members are TCA cycle reactions with protein lipoylation and Fe-S cluster assembly maturing TCA enzymes, distinguishing them from confusables on PDH/coenzyme A, the malate-aspartate shuttle and lysine/glycine catabolism.

name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members negatively regulate VEGF signalling and endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis and migration in sprouting, whereas confusables are pro-angiogenic or about cell adhesion signalling.

qualifier: L1-family nodal axon adhesion and connexin gap junctions
name: Nodal axon adhesion complexes and connexin gap junctions
rationale: Members combine L1/neurofascin-ankyrin node and paranode organisation with connexin gap junction assembly, both serving electrical signal propagation, unlike confusables on neuronal adhesion, L1 signalling and myelination.
